title: Value of Support Provided to Ubisoft Singapore and KPIs to Ensure Local Talent Development and Leadership Placements
what_it_is: Value of Support Provided to Ubisoft Singapore and KPIs to Ensure Local Talent Development and Leadership Placements

sections.label: Government support conditions and clawbacks
sections.summary: Companies receiving Government support must meet outcomes like job creation, and subsidies can be clawed back if conditions are unmet, though agreement details stay confidential.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Companies that receive Government support are required to meet key outcomes, such as job creation and local employment, business spending, or fixed asset investment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Government has mechanisms to claw back subsidies from companies that fail to meet the imposed conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are unable to disclose the details of agreements with individual companies due to confidentiality clauses and commercial sensitivities.

sections.label: Clawback mechanisms and prudent administration
sections.summary: Breach of terms may lead to revocation of incentives or clawback of benefits, and the Government ensures prudent administration through evaluation, monitoring and clawback mechanisms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: As I mentioned, we cannot comment on individual company agreements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But I would say that for the claw-back mechanisms, companies may be subject to potential revocation of their existing incentives or claw back of its associated benefits in the event of breach of terms and conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But I wanted to assure the Member also that the Government ensures prudent administration of tax incentives through a rigorous process that includes those claw-back mechanisms but also a pre-approval evaluation and also regular monitoring.

sections.label: Ubisoft training Singaporeans and PRs
sections.summary: Ubisoft has been established for about 15 years and has trained over 780 Singaporeans and Permanent Residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: First, probably the Member knows, Ubisoft has been established for about 15 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: They have trained over 780 Singaporeans and Permanent Residents (PRs).

sections.label: Ubisoft Singapore developers and interns
sections.summary: Ubisoft onboarded about 150 interns over 15 years, and over 80 Ubisoft Singapore developers worked on the Omi and Wakasa regions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I met with Justin Ng, who is a producer, and their teams produced a few titles, including the upcoming anticipated title, Assassin's Creed Shadows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: They have also onboarded about 150 interns over the last 15 years and have been producing content.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, they worked on the Omi and Wakasa regions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And over 80 Ubisoft Singapore developers and members were involved.
